name: Lil Bub
bio: Lil Bub was the internet's most magical space cat: a perma-kitten with a protruding tongue, extra toes on every paw, and a heart bigger than her tiny frame. Star of 'Lil Bub & Friendz', talk-show host, and philanthropist who raised hundreds of thousands of dollars for special-needs pets.
awards: Tribeca Film Festival: Best Feature Documentary, 'Lil Bub & Friendz' (2013)
